note: Real. NASA FIRMS MODIS C6.1 and VIIRS daily counts (brady/brazil-data). aqua, snpp, noaa20 = raw monthly counts of all daytime detections. fixed = Aqua count before 2012 (Aqua's clock had not drifted), then S-NPP count x the 2012-2020 Aqua/S-NPP ratio for that calendar month, in Aqua units; lo/hi from the block bootstrap of that ratio; S-NPP outage days filled with NOAA-20 x 1.037. outage flag = 3 or more S-NPP outage days in the month. median_ref = median fixed count for that calendar month, 2002-2025.
